name: Suvarna Mahal
why_it_matters: Inside the former Maharaja's banquet hall at Rambagh Palace (Taj). Recipes drawn from four princely-state royal kitchens — Rajputana, Awadh, Hyderabad, Punjab. Tomorrow's grand dinner is set in the room where Sawai Man Singh II actually entertained guests.
insider_tip: Two seatings: 7pm and 9:30pm — the 7pm slot gets the gold-plated thali on a less-rushed kitchen. Reservations close 24-48 hours ahead in season.
signature_address: Rambagh Palace, Bhawani Singh Road, C-Scheme, Jaipur 302005

name: Steam
why_it_matters: A restored vintage steam engine and carriage parked on tracks inside the Rambagh Palace gardens — the dining room is the actual carriage interior with a Victorian-platform alfresco wing. The European wing of Rambagh's three restaurants (Suvarna Mahal handles Indian, Polo Bar handles drinks).
insider_tip: The carriage seats only 16; the platform alfresco is where families end up. Reserve carriage seats for couples — peacocks wander the lawn at dusk.
signature_address: Rambagh Palace, Bhawani Singh Road, C-Scheme, Jaipur 302005

name: The Polo Bar
why_it_matters: Set up at Rambagh c.1930 to commemorate the Jaipur Polo team's international wins. Walls thick with polo trophies, silver mallets, and team photographs from Maharaja Man Singh II's era. The signature Polo Polotini is a vodka–melon liqueur house pour.
insider_tip: Open to non-residents but enter through Rambagh's south wing, not the main lobby. The hand-picked Cuban cigar selection is one of the few in north India and has its own walk-in humidor.
signature_address: Rambagh Palace, Bhawani Singh Road, C-Scheme, Jaipur 302005

name: Cinnamon
why_it_matters: Inside Jai Mahal Palace (Taj) in the former dining room of the Prime Minister of Jaipur State. Cuisine drawn from four princely-state kitchens — Rajputana, Awadh, Hyderabad, Kashmir — under a Rajput-style timber ceiling. Doesn't serve alcohol.
insider_tip: Go for the four-state thali, not à la carte — the kitchen is built around the thali rotation. No alcohol means lunch is the better slot than dinner if you want a long sit-down.
signature_address: Jai Mahal Palace, Jacob Road, Civil Lines, Jaipur 302006

name: Peshawri
why_it_matters: ITC's flagship North-West Frontier kitchen at the Rajputana property — the same Dal Bukhara recipe (lentils slow-cooked 18 hours over charcoal) and Sikandari Raan that made the brand at ITC Maurya in Delhi. Cutlery is wooden by design; you eat with your hands and naan.
insider_tip: Order Dal Bukhara and one tandoor item — that's the Peshawri pairing the chefs design around. The naan is wider than the plate.
signature_address: ITC Rajputana, Palace Road, Gopalbari, Jaipur 302006
